findings.title: Joomla JCE Extension CVE-2026-48907 — CISA KEV-Added 2026-06-17 With BOD 26-04 3-Day FCEB Deadline 2026-06-20; Automated Mass-Exploitation Active (CVSS 10.0)
findings.affected_technology: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor (JCE Pro) — all versions before 2.9.99.6
findings.summary: Unauthenticated improper-access-control flaw in Joomla JCE Pro lets attackers create editor profiles and upload PHP for code execution; CISA KEV-added 2026-06-17 with BOD 26-04 3-day federal deadline 2026-06-20 and automated public-exploit attacks in the wild.

findings.title: FortiBleed — 73,932 Fortinet SSL VPN URLs / ~75K FortiGate Devices Exposed With Plaintext Credentials + Configuration Data (Russian-Speaking Multi-Operator Group, 1.16B Credential Attempts)
findings.affected_technology: Fortinet FortiGate SSL VPN + management interfaces
findings.summary: Diachenko found a Russian-speaking server logging 1.16B FortiGate VPN credential attempts plus plaintext creds for 73,932 firewall URLs in 194 countries (verified Chevron / Samsung / Foxconn / AT&T admin creds) with ~30K devices still online per SOCRadar.

findings.title: Mastra npm Supply-Chain Compromise — 144 @mastra/* Packages Backdoored Via Hijacked Contributor Account + 'easy-day-js' Trojanized Dependency
findings.summary: Attackers hijacked a former @mastra maintainer's npm account and within 88 minutes injected a trojanized 'easy-day-js' postinstall loader into 144 packages, harvesting browser data + 160+ crypto wallets and polling C2 for second-stage modules cross-platform.

findings.title: Apache DolphinScheduler 6-CVE Batch — Authorization / Privilege-Escalation / Permission-Check-Bypass Cluster Via Apache Security Mailing List
findings.summary: Apache DolphinScheduler 6-CVE authorization batch (DataSource leak, /v2 bypass, alert/workflow over-disclosure, regular-user → admin token escalation, workflow-deletion bypass) disclosed via openwall oss-security 2026-06-17.

noted.summary: Yesterday's NOTED 'RoguePlanet zero-day' now has CVE assigned (CVSS 7.8) + Microsoft confirms patch in development + Positive Technologies reports in-wild exploitation; strict-scope-borderline local-only LPE → SYSTEM via race condition, monitoring through next Patch Tuesday.
LDAP DN injection in DefaultLdapRealm authentication component (openwall oss-security 2026-06-17); pending CVSS, watch for upgrade guidance from Apache Shiro project.

LPE chain to root with public exploit code and in-wild exploitation evidence per Positive Technologies 'In the Trend of VM' #28 (avleonov 2026-06-17); pure local-LPE = strict-scope skip, monitoring only.
LPE with public exploit per avleonov 2026-06-17 'In the Trend of VM' #28; lab repository BenedictEjepu/CVE-2026-46300-Fragnesia on GitHub; strict-scope skip, monitoring only.

Unauthenticated RCE on PAN-OS appliances per avleonov 2026-06-17 'In the Trend of VM' #28 with publicly available exploit; pending mainstream-news cross-reference before promotion — would land in same 2026-Q2 perimeter-VPN cluster as CVE-2026-0257 and CVE-2026-50751.
Denial-of-service via large SamplesPerPixel tag (openwall 2026-06-17); affects image-processing pipelines that ingest user-supplied TIFFs — relevant to multimedia-parser pipeline isolation pattern.
Out-of-bounds read in Text Property count (openwall 2026-06-17); bounded impact, relevant only to plugin-rich Vim setups loading untrusted files.

Improper access control and IOCTL vulnerabilities in SignalRGB kernel driver (CERT/CC 2026-06-17); local-LPE class, strict-scope skip for Watchtower-grade fleets but relevant to gaming-PC / kernel-driver attack surface.
Kodak acknowledged a security breach claimed by the ShinyHunters extortion gang (BleepingComputer 2026-06-17); continues the ShinyHunters PeopleSoft / Council of Europe / Salesforce campaign cadence.

Oracle June 2026 Critical Patch Update delivers 245 patches across Communications, EBS, Enterprise Manager and other product families (SecurityWeek 2026-06-17); watch the Communications and EBS CVE list for any KEV-grade items in the next 48h triage.

Threat actors leveraged paid posts on legitimate news sites, fake reviews, and coordinated VirusTotal trusted-comment accounts to inflate download counts and reputations (THN 2026-06-17); new tradecraft data point — VirusTotal community comments now gameable, should not be trusted as a reputation signal.

noted.product: JetBrains Marketplace malicious AI-plugin telemetry expansion (Aikido)
noted.summary: Aikido follow-up on 2026-06-17 JetBrains NEWS — 7 vendor accounts, ~70K total installs (DeepSeek AI Assist 27,727 + CodeGPT AI Assistant 25,571 as top two), unencrypted HTTP exfil to 39.107.60[.]51; same incident, no material score change.

Threat actors leveraged recursive NTFS junctions to generate unbounded valid file paths, causing Microsoft Defender scans to never complete (BleepingComputer 2026-06-16); new evasion tradecraft relevant to EDR-posture review, not a vulnerability per se.

Microsoft confirmed an issue preventing third-party applications from launching Microsoft Office or opening documents on updated Windows systems (BleepingComputer 2026-06-17); operational not security, but security teams should anticipate user-facing tickets misattributing the issue to Defender / EDR.
